title: Symmetric Mahler volume product
statement: Every origin-symmetric convex body K in R^d satisfies vol(K)·vol(K°)≥4^d/d!.

counterexample.description: An origin-symmetric rational \(d\)-polytope with \(\operatorname{vol}(K)\operatorname{vol}(K^\circ)<4^d/d!\). Exact polar construction and rational triangulation volumes form a certificate.
